name: Void Skills
description: Skills for the Void autonomous agent framework

skills.name: Autoresearch
skills.description: Evolve a skill by generating variations, evaluating them, and updating the best version

skills.name: cost-report
skills.description: Weekly API cost report — reads token usage CSV, computes dollar costs per skill and model, reports trends

skills.name: Create Skill
skills.description: Generate a complete new skill from a one-line prompt

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.description: Exhaustive multi-source synthesis on any topic using full-context ingestion — far beyond a digest

skills.name: Farcaster Digest
skills.description: Trending and relevant Farcaster casts filtered by crypto, prediction markets, and coordination topics

skills.name: Fetch Tweets
skills.description: Search X/Twitter for tweets about a token, keyword, username, or topic

skills.name: Fleet Control
skills.description: Monitor managed Void instances — check health, dispatch skills, aggregate status

skills.name: fork-fleet
skills.description: Inventory active Void forks, detect diverged work, surface upstream contribution candidates

skills.name: GitHub Monitor
skills.description: Watch repos for stale PRs, new issues, and new releases

skills.name: GitHub Trending
skills.description: Top 10 trending repos on GitHub right now

skills.name: Hacker News Digest
skills.description: Top HN stories filtered by keywords relevant to your interests

skills.name: Heartbeat
skills.description: Proactive ambient check — surface anything worth attention

skills.name: Last 30 Days
skills.description: Cross-platform social research — what people are actually saying about a topic across Reddit, X, HN, Polymarket, and the web over the last 30 days

skills.name: Monitor Polymarket
skills.description: Monitor specific prediction markets for 24h price moves, volume changes, and fresh comments

skills.name: On-Chain Monitor
skills.description: Monitor blockchain addresses and contracts for notable activity

skills.name: PR Review
skills.description: Auto-review open PRs on watched repos and post summary comments

skills.name: Regulatory Monitor
skills.description: Track legislation, regulatory actions, and legal developments affecting prediction markets, crypto, and AI agents

skills.name: RSS Digest
skills.description: Fetch, summarize, and deliver RSS feed highlights

skills.name: Security Digest
skills.description: Monitor recent security advisories from the GitHub Advisory Database for tracked ecosystems

skills.name: self-improve
skills.description: Improve the agent itself — better skills, prompts, workflows, and config based on recent performance

skills.name: Skill Evals
skills.description: Evaluate skill output quality against assertion manifests — detects regressions before users notice

skills.name: Skill Health
skills.description: Audit skill quality metrics, detect API degradation, and report health trends

skills.name: Skill Repair
skills.description: Diagnose and fix failing or degraded skills automatically

skills.name: Skill Security Scan
skills.description: Audit imported skills for shell injection, secret exfiltration, path traversal, and prompt injection before they run

skills.name: Spawn Instance
skills.description: Clone this Void agent into a new GitHub repo — fork, configure skills, register in fleet

skills.name: Token Alert
skills.description: Notify on price or volume anomalies for tracked tokens

skills.name: Token Movers
skills.description: Top movers, losers, and trending coins from CoinGecko

skills.name: Vuln Scanner
skills.description: Fork trending repos, audit for security vulnerabilities, and PR fixes

skills.name: weekly-shiplog
skills.description: Weekly narrative of everything shipped — features, fixes, and momentum, written as a compelling update

skills.name: Write Tweet
skills.description: Generate 10 tweet drafts across 5 size tiers (2 variations each) on a topic from today's outputs
